attested_response_positions: 1.0 Welsh flow 3 — 'Actually, I'd rather stick to English today if that's alright, love. I'm not feeling up to it.' → 'Of course, no problem at all. English it is. Let's get you sorted.' → 'Thank you, love. No offence meant - I'm just tired today.' → 'None taken at all.'

2.0 Welsh flow 2 — 'To be honest, doctor, with something medical I'd feel safer in English. I want to be sure I follow everything.' → 'That's completely sensible, and exactly the right instinct. English it is - clarity matters most here.' → 'No offence to your Welsh, now.' → 'None taken at all - you've done me a favour.'
survivability.recovery_note: Twice, complete both times: yield instantly, ratify the choice as sensible, de-personalise the refusal, re-anchor rapport — with a mutual face-repair tail ('no offence meant' / 'none taken') in both cycles.
survivability.why_not_already_recorded: The 2026-08-30 mapping assigned these exchanges N7 + P101 (composition C109), which captures the turns but not the edge: no store or proposed survivability edge covers the learner's own language project being declined, and the S101–S107 set has no edge on N101 at all. For a language course this is the emotional core of the corpus: the learner's offer is refused, it costs nothing, and the refuser thanks them.
survivability.recommendation: To ratification alongside the 1xx set; should travel with N101 into every sector pod that carries the linguistic-situation opener.
